other.remelting: at least seven times, flipping between each melt

evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with nominal compositions of NbTaTiV, NbTaVW, and NbTaTiVW (compositions in at.%) were synthesized by vacuum arc melting of the equimolar pure metals (weight percentage purity ≥ 99.9%) in a Ti-gettered, high-purity argon atmosphere. Arc melting of the alloys was conducted on a water-cooled copper hearth crucible. To achieve as homogeneous distribution of elements as possible in the alloys using this melting technique, the ingots were remelted at least seven times, flipping them over between each melt.

evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with nominal compositions of NbTaTiV, NbTaVW, and NbTaTiVW (compositions in at.%) were synthesized by vacuum arc melting of the equimolar pure metals (weight percentage purity ≥ 99.9%) in a Ti-gettered, high-purity argon atmosphere. Arc melting of the alloys was conducted on a water-cooled copper hearth crucible. To achieve as homogeneous distribution of elements as possible in the alloys using this melting technique, the ingots were remelted at least seven times, flipping them over between each melt.

In agreement with the qualitative analysis of the backscattered electron imaging (BEI) SEM images, the distribution of the elements in the as-cast alloys is inhomogeneous.
